text.p: Bayern Munich have made an offer for Stuttgart's disenchanted Brazilian striker Giovane Elber, a German newspaper reported on Friday.
Club president Franz Beckenbauer was aware that Elber, whose contract expires at the end of June, had received offers from abroad, Sportbild said.
"We will nevertheless make a renewed offer to (Stuttgart president Gerhard) Mayer-Vorfelder," Beckenbauer was quoted as saying.
Bayern offered Stuttgart more than 10 million marks ($6.4 million) for Elber a year ago but the bid was rejected.
Beckenbauer said he was confident Elber would move to Munich next season.
Elber wants a big wage increase and said earlier this week he was fed up with the slow progress of negotiations with Stuttgart. He threatened to leave Germany.
